title: Serve with one gathered awareness
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Do not let the day outrun this: let this stay with you: ego cannot make peace; Naam and service can.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes true when love is gathered toward the One.
source.lifeApplication: Before seva, gather the mind and lower the self.
